text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #595959

g.text: record was read against its cited sentences in a single assistant coding pass (Claude, 2026-10-22) and given a verdict on the model's label, an

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #595959

g.text: angle, and a policy direction; no human review yet. Years are hearing held years. Direction resolves the polarity of support and concern: a record

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #595959

g.text: favors stronger environmental regulation or a stronger EPA or less environmental regulation, or neither (shown in neither panel).
